traceability.notes:
Story 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT is fully implemented and verified.
The plugin now: - Parses @supports annotations as `@supports ...` and validates their format, using the same configurable patterns as @story/@req. - Deep-validates each requirement ID listed in @supports against the referenced story file, with requirement IDs scoped per story file and clear error messages including both reqId and storyPath. - Treats @supports as satisfying both the story-annotation requirement (require-story-annotation rule) and the requirement-annotation requirement (require-req-annotation rule), while preserving existing @story/@req behavior. - Supports mixed usage where @story, @req, and @supports can all appear in the same comment, function, and file without conflict. - Provides detailed error messages for malformed @supports lines (missing values, bad paths, invalid IDs) and for missing requirements, all covered by targeted Jest tests.
All acceptance criteria and listed technical requirements for this story are backed by concrete implementation and passing tests, so the assessment is PASSED.
